name: Ref-Gaussian Deferred Surfel Rendering with Split-Sum IBL
definition: A real-time rendering method for iPhone using Metal that relights 3D Gaussian Splatting models by decomposing splats into PBR materials (albedo, normal, roughness, reflectance) and computing lighting via a deferred shading pipeline with split-sum environment map integration.
summary: Ref-Gaussian Deferred Surfel Rendering with Split-Sum IBL is a physically based rendering method that prevents blurred reflective details by decomposing 2D Gaussian splats into material attributes and computing lighting via a deferred shading pipeline with split-sum environment map integration.
